description: Lists the guided compliance playbooks this server provides: the Fannie Mae AI lender letter (LL-2026-04) P&P review (AI inventory, AI governance policy, risk assessment, P&P updates, change log) and FHA, VA and USDA loan-file QC against the verbatim handbooks. Returns each playbook's id, what it does, when it applies and what the user provides. Playbook tools accept only ids and reference names, no document text; the user's P&Ps and loan files stay in their own chat.
name: list_playbooks

error.description: Present only on an error or refusal: not_found, ambiguous, unparsed, empty_terms, unknown_playbook, unknown_reference, offset_out_of_range, daily_capacity_reached.

fallback.description: On daily_capacity_reached: where the full corpus can be downloaded.

guidance.description: On a refusal or empty search: the server's explanation.

hint.description: On an error: the server's explanation.

next.description: The server's note on the next step.

notice.description: Terms notice: research use only, not legal advice.

resets.description: On daily_capacity_reached: when capacity resets (00:00 UTC).

title: List playbooks
